What people say about Harbour Tools

We asked customers about their experience.

I have bought from Harbour Tools for six years and the only time anything went wrong they replaced it without argument.

Another shopper was less impressed:

Harbour Tools shipping estimates are fiction. Three orders, three times late, and the tracking page never updates.

And a mixed view:

Good tools from Harbour Tools at a fair price, but the website search is hopeless and I always end up using Google instead.
